description: First-run setup AND license upgrades for GHL Command. Validates your license and GHL credentials, then writes them to a per-user credentials file; restart Claude once after it completes. UPGRADING an existing install (e.g. free key to paid)? Supply ONLY email + license_key — the GHL credentials and any Workflow Builder unlock already saved on this machine are reused and kept; do not re-enter ghl_api_key or ghl_location_id. No license yet? Paid ($97/mo) at https://ghlcommand.com — or a FREE read-only key, instantly, at https://ghlcommand.com/free.

firebase_paste.description: (Workflow Builder, one-paste path) Paste the JSON output from auto_capture_firebase_script here. Replaces the three separate Firebase fields below.

ghl_api_key.description: GHL Private Integration key (starts with 'pit-'). Created INSIDE the sub-account at Settings > Integrations > Private Integrations. OMIT together with ghl_location_id to reuse the pair already saved on this machine (upgrades).

ghl_company_id.description: (Agency only) Company ID for multi-location access.

ghl_firebase_api_key.description: (Workflow Builder, manual path) Firebase API Key starting with 'AIza'. Prefer firebase_paste instead.

ghl_firebase_refresh_token.description: (Workflow Builder, manual path) Firebase refresh token. Prefer firebase_paste instead.

ghl_location_id.description: GHL Location ID (sub-account ID). Found in your GHL URL: /location/THIS_PART/dashboard. OMIT together with ghl_api_key to reuse the saved pair (upgrades).

ghl_user_id.description: (Workflow Builder, manual path) Firebase User ID. Prefer firebase_paste instead.

license_key.description: License key from your purchase email.

name: setup_ghl_mcp
